|showheader = n }} The '''Grave Stone''' is a decorative piece of [[furniture]] that can be purchased from [[Pierre]]'s stand at the [[Spirit's Eve]] festival for {{Price|350}} or on [[Winter|Winter 15]] from the [[Night Market#Magic Shop Boat|Magic Shop Boat]] at the [[Night Market]] for {{Price|200}}. It can be won from the Crane Game inside the [[Movie Theater]], during {{season|fall}}. It may be placed anywhere in [[Stardew Valley]], indoors or out. ==History== {{History|1.3.27|Introduced.}} {{History|1.4|Can now be obtained from Crane Game in the Movie Theater.
